nodes.name: When called by the poll
nodes.notes: One planned write per call, from the poll's Write gate. callerPolicy lets only the poll call this.

parameters.claimsJson: ={{ JSON.stringify({ iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) - 60, exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 540, iss: /^\d+$/.test(String($('When called by the poll').first().json.app_id)) ? Number($('When called by the poll').first().json.app_id) : '' }) }}

nodes.name: Sign App JWT
nodes.notes: RS256 with the App private key from the jwtAuth credential overwrite. Valid for 9 minutes.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ repositories: [String($('When called by the poll').first().json.repo).split('/')[1]], permissions: { issues: 'write', pull_requests: 'write', statuses: 'write', metadata: 'read' } }) }}

nodes.name: Installation token
nodes.notes: Scoped to the one repository and the write permissions the plan needs. Expires after an hour; never returned to the poll.

parameters.output: ={{ $('Installation token').first().json.statusCode === 201 && typeof ($('Installation token').first().json.body || {}).token === 'string' ? ['create_comment', 'edit_comment', 'set_status', 'ensure_label', 'remove_label', 'add_label'].indexOf($('When called by the poll').first().json.type) + 1 : 0 }}

nodes.name: Route write
nodes.notes: 0: no token or an unknown write type, straight to Result. 1-6: one output per write type.

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('When called by the poll').first().json.repo }}/issues/{{ Number($('When called by the poll').first().json.pr) }}/comments
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ body: $('When called by the poll').first().json.body }) }}

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('When called by the poll').first().json.repo }}/issues/comments/{{ Number($('When called by the poll').first().json.comment_id) }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ body: $('When called by the poll').first().json.body }) }}

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('When called by the poll').first().json.repo }}/statuses/{{ $('When called by the poll').first().json.sha }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ state: $('When called by the poll').first().json.state, context: 'pr-triage/verdict', description: $('When called by the poll').first().json.description }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ name: ['triage:blocked', 'triage:deep-review', 'triage:review', 'triage:low-risk', 'triage:human', 'merge', 'merge-watched'].includes($('When called by the poll').first().json.name) ? $('When called by the poll').first().json.name : '', color: $('When called by the poll').first().json.color, description: $('When called by the poll').first().json.description }) }}

nodes.name: Create label
nodes.notes: A 422 (already exists) counts as done when the readback finds the label.

parameters.url: ={{ ['triage:blocked', 'triage:deep-review', 'triage:review', 'triage:low-risk', 'triage:human', 'merge', 'merge-watched'].includes($('When called by the poll').first().json.name) ? 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + $('When called by the poll').first().json.repo + '/issues/' + Number($('When called by the poll').first().json.pr) + '/labels/' + encodeURIComponent($('When called by the poll').first().json.name) : 'https://api.github.com/rate_limit' }}

nodes.name: Remove label
nodes.notes: Only rule-1 names reach the label path; anything else is sent to /rate_limit, which refuses a DELETE.

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('When called by the poll').first().json.repo }}/issues/{{ Number($('When called by the poll').first().json.pr) }}/labels
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ labels: ['triage:blocked', 'triage:deep-review', 'triage:review', 'triage:low-risk', 'triage:human', 'merge', 'merge-watched'].includes($('When called by the poll').first().json.name) ? [$('When called by the poll').first().json.name] : [] }) }}

parameters.url: ={{ Number(($json.body || {}).id) > 0 ? 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + $('When called by the poll').first().json.repo + '/issues/comments/' + Number($json.body.id) : 'https://api.github.com/rate_limit' }}
=https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('When called by the poll').first().json.repo }}/commits/{{ $('When called by the poll').first().json.sha }}/statuses?per_page=100
